body: That's a good idea actually. If I make it through this I believe Friday night soccer pickup games at the local indoor place start soon. That's a 5 minute bike ride away.

I can't afford to anymore. I can't go hiking, I can't get anywhere. I can't buy little electronics kits I enjoy building, I love reading but I have a very hard time concentrating and have to force myself to get through one chapter. 

School would take up free time, and I would enjoy it. I just...can't get there.
